why: Lets the reversal value `solid` through as if it were a style (issue #922). The renderer happens to draw a solid ring for it, because `ringMarkerFor` maps any unknown style to none, but the HUD's `identityMarkerIcon` draws the `shape` outline for any style that is neither `arcs` nor `roof`, so the one way back to the pre-ruling strip draws the shipped mark. Killed by the resolver's reversal cases, the loop case that boots an FFA session with `solid`, and the page-HUD case.
killedBy: sessionIdentityMarker: what a session renderer draws (issue #922) draws no marker for the reversal value, in every mode -- population: 4 modes
stripIdentityMarker: what the page HUD draws on FFA entries (issue #922) draws the shipped mark unflagged, none for the reversal value, and a named style as named

startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default the shipped FFA identity marker reaches FFA sessions only (issue #922) draws the solid ring in an FFA session for the reversal value, and a named style in any mode
createBrowserDeps carries the parsed browser query state into GameDeps hands the page HUD the shipped FFA identity mark, and none for the reversal value (issue #922)
